summary: Council voted 9-0 to stop accepting data center and battery storage applications until December 2027 while studying grid, water, safety, traffic and noise impacts.
notes: One of several jurisdictions pausing data centers and battery energy storage together in a single instrument, alongside Hillsboro's Resolution No. 2932. A separate county-level moratorium is reported to remain in effect.
confidence_note: Ordinance not read. Whether the two uses are defined jointly or separately in the text is NOT_CHECKED, and that determines whether standalone storage is caught.
